title: Biodome Prototype
sideASummary: Player deck back. Dark blue sunburst around a haven on the water. No text and no printed code.
sideBSummary: Unrationed Event, Biodome Prototype. Place up to 3 shelters on any cities on the grid. Destroy this card after use. Play at any time. Not an action. Printed code P3-02b.

rules: Unrationed Event. Play at any time. It is not an action.
Place up to 3 shelter figures on any cities that are on the grid. The cities do not have to match a card, and they do not have to be the city you are in.
Destroy this card after use. It does not go to the discard pile.
When the package is opened, give this card to a player to add to their hand.
notes: Side A is the Player deck back and has no printed code. Side B is P3-02b.
The card does not say what to do if fewer than the number you want are left in the Shelters bag. Rule N's move-a-shelter line is printed on the Build Shelter action, not on this event.
The picture is a cracked screen showing a green dome.
